reference_sql:
WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per account created in 2024
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
),
mrr_end AS (  -- one row per cohort account, with its MRR on 31 December 2025
  SELECT c.account_id, c.cohort_month, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS mrr
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = c.account_id
  WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY c.account_id, c.cohort_month
)
SELECT cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_accounts,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mrr > 0) AS paying_at_end
FROM mrr_end
GROUP BY cohort_month
alternatives:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', a.created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_accounts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.mrr > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paying_at_end
FROM accounts a
JOIN (  -- one row per account, with its MRR on 31 December 2025
  SELECT account_id, SUM(mrr_delta_local) AS mrr
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
) AS m ON m.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE date_part('year', a.created_at) = 2024
GROUP BY 1

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', a.created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_accounts,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (SELECT SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) FROM subscription_events e
                               WHERE e.account_id = a.account_id AND e.event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31') > 0) AS paying_at_end
FROM accounts a
WHERE a.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND a.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1

solver.query:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
),
mrr_end AS (
  SELECT c.account_id, c.cohort_month, COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local), 0) AS mrr
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = c.account_id AND e.event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY c.account_id, c.cohort_month
)
SELECT cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_accounts,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mrr > 0) AS paying_at_end
FROM mrr_end
GROUP BY cohort_month
